calibration.queries: every farm training and dev message (English, Spanish, Korean and Quechua), with examples from its own family left out
calibration.objective: right first spots gained minus 3 times right first spots lost, over both memories, k = 1 to 3 and all draws
calibration.groups: messages that pass the language check (English, Spanish, Korean), compared by embedding cosine, and those that do not, compared by spelling-sketch cosine; each pair chosen on its own messages
calibration.ties: the higher similarity, then the higher lead

ship: With no examples, every decision equals the published run (88 of 88 held-out, 44 of 44 route).
Quechua: on the held-out farm messages with a Quechua memory, the right spot comes first for at least 3 more of the 16 messages naming one at k = 3 (mean over draws), and top-3 does not fall.
English, Spanish and Korean: for each language, place, memory and k, the mean over draws of top-1, top-3 and as-expected answers is not below k = 0, and confident wrong answers are not above it.
